project_info.theme: Botanical noir fragrance hero for YSL Tuxedo

main_subject.detail: A YSL fragrance bottle stands centered on a reflective black base, labeled 'TUXEDO' and 'SHARP PATCHOULI'. Dark green leaves frame the bottle from both sides against a nearly black background.
main_subject.style: Luxury fragrance hero packshot, botanical noir still life, refined masculine perfume advertising

items: Top Left: Softly blurred dark foliage in the black background
Top Right: Bright green leaf entering from the right edge
Bottom Left: Amber reflections glowing through the bottle base
Bottom Right: Reflective black surface beneath the bottle
Center/Background: Rectangular YSL perfume bottle with amber liquid, black textured cap, and central black label reading 'TUXEDO' and 'SHARP PATCHOULI'

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm amber inner glow, crisp glass edges, deep shadow falloff, subtle botanical highlights
